verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says its AI Agents answer calls automatically, including after-hours calls, peak volume and repetitive requests (aircall-docs-24). The pricing page describes agent-style actions such as pulling order details and logging outcomes in the CRM (aircall-docs-21). That covers the 'answer the line' part, but no evidence says the AI agent takes a message or hands a live call to a human, and the shared-inbox 'step in' claim covers conversations generally, not handoff from an AI call. Missing for 10: documented AI message-taking, documented AI-to-human call handoff/escalation, in-depth AI agent docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
